values.note: Book online through the park's ResNexus page or by phone. Cancel at least 7 days ahead to avoid a one-night fee. Rates for two people, max 6 per site. note: RV park 10 mi south of Montrose on US-550 (23449 Highway 550) with San Juan Mountain views; wide, alternating-direction sites with grass and trees between. Highly rated transient park (RV Life ~9.2/10, 4.5★). --Claude
summary: Operator site (live, own domain, phone 970-240-3832 and address match): confirmed 60 pull-through full-hookup 50-amp sites, laundry, $70/$75 nightly. Added showers, booking via ResNexus with the cancellation/occupancy/rig-age terms, monthly rates in the fee note. Note cleaned of field restatements ($$ tier, amenities, hookup detail).
flags: Price gate: $70/$75 is over US$50, but gateways.py puts it in the Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP gateway at 24 km, which lifts the price half of the gate. Keep.

Long-stay tests (pass): it also sells months ($950/$1,000 peak, $800/$900 off-peak + metered electric). (1) gateway-lifted price; (2) nights sold on its own site with a posted nightly rate, phone, and a ResNexus engine selling single nights, with no application or lease; (3) no minimum stated; (4) no site split published (no count = pass); (5) not a home community (60 RV sites, no homes or lots sold).
Rig age rule: RVs 'no more than 10 years old' (park rules) / 'no more than 20 years old' (rates page), exceptions case-by-case. EKKO (2023) passes until 2033 under the stricter figure.
Season: no open dates are stated. The off-peak monthly rate (Oct 1 - Apr 30) implies year-round operation, but year_round was not set from it.
Discounts: the stored good_sam false (Good Sam directory, derived) was left alone; the operator site says nothing about Good Sam.
Pin 38.34198,-107.78993 is on the office/entrance at the north end of the RV site grid. OK. Not waterfront confirmed: farmland all round, only a small ornamental pond by the office.
